deviations.edit: Seed fix: enable_genetech_hotlist=true on QA orgs 5/6 in .context/qa-seed.tinker.php so seeded admins reach the admin panel (User::canAccessPanel gate). Seed-only, no app code.

UX rework (Dalton, human QA): Scout moved from a separate right-hand Toggle section into the Roles card as a peer Checkbox ('Scout'), with the Assigned Kit picker beneath it; still the clarity-scout permission (not a role). Presentation-only in ProvisionsScoutUser.php + UsersResource.php; reconcile/permission/kit logic unchanged. 55 filtered tests still pass.

UX (Dalton): Create User form now pre-checks 'Default User' by default (roles CheckboxList formatStateUsing defaults to the USER role on create; Edit still hydrates real roles). So a Scout user = check Scout + pick kit. Added test_create_form_defaults_roles_to_default_user. 56 filtered tests pass.

REVISED the default-role behavior (Dalton): reverted the unconditional 'pre-check Default User for all creates'. Now Default User is force-checked ONLY when Scout is checked (and re-checked if removed while Scout stays on, so a Scout user keeps the base role); with Scout off, roles behave exactly as original (nothing pre-checked). Implemented via scout_access + roles afterStateUpdated (no disableOptionWhen — a disabled option is dropped from the valid `in:` set and would reject its own value). Tests: does-not-pre-check, enabling-scout-force-checks, re-check-on-removal, not-forced-when-off. 59 filtered tests pass; browser-confirmed.
Scout checkbox help text simplified to 'Enable Clarity Scout driver-portal access for this user.' (no mention of permission/role/kit) per Dalton.

Assigned Kit is now REQUIRED when Scout is checked (and only shown then) — resolves the earlier 'half-provisioned allowed' open question: Scout+no-kit is now a validation error. Updated test (test_scout_requires_a_kit_when_enabled) + 2 edit tests now supply a kit.
deviations.ac_delta: was: Scout could be saved with no kit (half-provisioned allowed) -> now: kit required when Scout on
